definition: You use about to say what subject something is related to.
example: Let's not talk about her problems.

definition: If A is above B, A is higher than or before B, but not touching B.
example: In a newspaper, the title of a story is usually above the story.

definition: An action is something that you do, or something that happens, especially with motion.
example: At 3 am, just west of the building, the plan was put into action.

definition: When a person or animal has activity, it is active or lively.
example: The sleeping dog did not show much activity.

definition: An actor is a person (usually male) who performs as a character in a play or other theatrical work. A female performer is called either an actress or an actor.
example: The actor received a Tony Award.

definition: If you add x to y, you put x and y together.
example: Cook for five minutes, then add the remaining spices to the soup.

definition: To be afraid of someone or something means to be scared of someone or something; to have a fear of someone or something.
example: I'm afraid of snakes. I can't even go near them.

definition: Behind something in place or position.
example: "B" comes after "A" in the alphabet.

definition: Period between midday to sunset.
example: I didn't finish that work in the morning, so I had to do it in the afternoon.

definition: Something's age is how long it has existed or been alive; how old something is.
example: The boy said he was age five.

definition: When two people agree about something, they have the same ideas. They both think the same things are true.
example: We agree that it will probably rain this afternoon.

definition: An airplane is a vehicle with wings that can fly.
example: Can we hurry? I have to catch an airplane to Miami.

definition: An airport is a place where airplanes land and take off.
example: I took a taxi to the airport for my flight to London.

definition: All of something is 100% of it, or the entire amount.
example: Well, you could stay in bed all day on Friday. And I could take the kids to school.

definition: When something is all right, that means that it is in good condition.
example: My car is all right.

definition: Something that went quite well.
example: The soccer tournament went all right, I guess.

definition: Very nearly; not the same, but near to being the same.
example: I am almost ready to go. I will be ready very soon.

definition: before a certain time (often now)
example: When we met, his first wife was already dead.

definition: When one thing happens and a second thing happens in a same or similar time or way, then the second thing also happens.
example: We bought bread at the store. We also bought milk.

definition: If something always happens, it happens at all times or every time.
example: For all of my life, the sun has always risen every day.

definition: Upset in an aggressive way.
example: He embarrassed her, so she was angry.

definition: An animal is any living thing that can move. People are not animals, but are said to be animals, under the scientific definition. .
example: Dogs, elephants, and horses are all animals.

definition: An answer is something that someone says after another person asks (says) a question.
example: The answer to your question is "no".

definition: To respond.
example: He answers all my questions.

definition: An apple is a sweet, red, yellow or green fruit.
example: I gave my teacher an apple.

definition: An apron is a piece of clothing that is worn to protect from spills.
example: Chefs at this restaurant are required to wear aprons.

definition: If x is around y, y is in the middle and x is on all sides of y.
example: The moon circles around the Earth.

definition: If you arrive somewhere, you come to that place, usually the place that you planned to go to.
example: Is everything ready? I expect the guests to arrive soon.

definition: An art is a skill that produces works of creative expression and can be mastered through study and practice. Arts are often contrasted with sciences.
example: Painting, music and writing are arts.

definition: An article is a member of a larger group.
example: A shirt is an article of clothing.

definition: To ask is to look for an answer to a question by saying it.
example: She sure does ask a lot of questions!

definition: Your aunt is the sister of your mother or father.
example: After my parents died, we went to live with my aunt.

definition: If you are awake, you are not asleep.
example: It was 1:00 AM and Gerard was still awake.

definition: A baby is a very young child, less than two years old, who has not yet learned how to speak.
example: I used to be a baby but now I am an adult.

definition: The back is the rear part of something; it is the part in the other direction from the front.
example: I went to the back of the house.

definition: If something is bad, it is not good.
example: The man who killed his wife was very bad.

definition: Bags are containers made of soft material like paper, plastic or leather.
example: I put the garbage in a black plastic bag.

definition: A ball is a round thing. People often use them to play games.
example: The croquet ball was hit through the wicket and the game was over.

definition: A band is a group of people working together.
example: Those in the army who fought closely together in the war were called a band of brothers.

definition: A building where you can keep and borrow money.
example: I have to stop at the bank to deposit my check and get money for tonight.

definition: A bar is a place that sells alcoholic drinks.
example: I'm going to drink beer at the bar.

definition: A sport where you try to hit a ball so that you can run to four bases, causing a run. The team with the most runs after nine or more innings wins.
example: The New York Yankees are a baseball team.

definition: A ball game with two teams of five players. A goal is scored when a player throws the ball into a net (attached to a hoop) at each end of the court.
example: I play on my school's basketball team.

definition: A long, high basin that you put water in and go in to wash your body.
example: Jane put in water up to the top of the bath.

definition: A bathroom is a room that has a bathtub or a shower.
example: In our house, the bathroom is very busy in the morning.

definition: A large area of sand (or very small stones), next to an area of water.
example: People sometimes lie on beaches when they are on holiday, to get a suntan.

definition: Beans are the seeds of one family of plants that people often cook and eat.
example: Put the dried beans in water overnight. They should be soft and ready to cook in the morning.

definition: A bear is a big animal with a short tail. They either eat only meat or meat and plants. There are many different types of bears, for example brown bears and polar bears.
example: Polar bears are white.

definition: If something is beautiful, it is very good to look at it.
example: Look at that beautiful bird!

definition: If x becomes y, it changes into y or changes to be more y.
example: The boy has become a man.

definition: A piece of furniture to sleep on.
example: At night, I go to bed.

definition: A room in a house that is used for sleeping. This is where the bed is kept.
example: I hate camping. I wish I was back in my bedroom, sleeping in my own bed.

definition: A bee is a black and yellow striped insect with wings that makes honey. It has a stinger.
example: That bee is flying to the flower.

definition: If x happens before y, x happens first and y happens second.
example: He worked in a gas station before he became famous.

definition: When you begin something, you start to do the first part of a longer action.
example: A journey always begins with a first step.

definition: When something is behind a second thing, the first thing is in back of the second.
example: The ball is behind the box.

definition: When you believe, you have faith in something.
example: He believes in one God.

definition: A bell is an object that is shaped like a cup that makes a ringing sound when hit.
example: The church bell is ringing.

definition: The superlative form of good; most good.
example:
William is the best football player on our team.
Synonym: top

Antonym: worst

definition: The superlative form of well; most well.
example:
I'm feeling the best that I have in a while.
Antonym: worst

definition: The comparative form of good; more good.
example: I am a better person than you are.

definition: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels. You use your legs to make it move.
example: I learned to ride a bicycle when I was six years old.

definition: If something is big, it is large in size; tall, wide, long, or fat.
example: He's bigger than me.

definition: A bird is a warm-blooded animal that has feathers and wings and lays eggs. Most birds can fly.
example: A sparrow is a bird and so is a penguin, even though it cannot fly.

definition: A birth is when a new baby comes out of its mother.
example: My mother gave birth to my brother at 12:00 on Dec. 31st.

definition: The day you were born.
example: They will need your birthday on the application.

definition: A biscuit is a cookie.
example: He brought along homemade biscuits for the picnic.

definition: A block is a hard piece of material, usually with six smooth sides.
example: When I was young, I liked building things with wooden blocks.

definition: If wind, air, etc. blows, it moves.
example: The wind is blowing and the trees are moving.

definition: If you are blue, you are sad.
example: He was very blue that day.

definition: One of the colors people can see
example: The sky was a deep blue above her and golden yellow beyond the village.

definition: A board is a group of people who govern something.
example: The school board has chosen new textbooks for all the schools.

definition: A boat is a vehicle used to travel on water.
example: At the lake, the children learn about fishing and boat safety.

definition: A body is the main part of a person, animal, physical object, or organisation.
example: After falling out of the tree, his arm was broken and his body hurt all over.

definition: Bones are the hard, white things inside your body. They give your body its shape.
example: How many bones did a dinosaur have?

definition: A book is a lot of paper joined together with writing and pictures printed on them for you to read or write in.
example: I borrow books from the library, and keep them in a bookcase.

definition: A bookstore is a store that sells books.
example: Which bookstore do you wish to go to?

definition: If something is boring, it is not interesting or makes you want to do something else.
example: Go to work, come home, sleep: life is so boring.

definition: If you borrow something from someone, you use it and then you give it back to them.
example: Governments need to make it easier for students to borrow money for school.

definition: When there are two things, both is the first thing and the second thing.
example: Jim took both the apple and the orange.

definition: A bottle is a container, usually made of glass that holds liquid and has a cap or stopper.
example: He drank cold water from a plastic bottle.

definition: The bottom of something is its lowest part.
example: Lucy took a pen and wrote her name at the bottom of the page.

definition: A bowl is a deep dish.
example: In large mixing bowl, stir together flours, baking powder, and salt until thoroughly combined.

definition: A box is a square container, usually with four sides, a top and a bottom.
example: We had big cardboard boxes filled with the stuff.

definition: A boy is a male child or teenager; someone who is not a man yet.
example: He had a pretty wife and two little ones: a boy and a girl.

definition: Boyfriend normally describes a boy or a young man, who is in a love relationship with another person, when they aren't married yet.
example: I didn't have a boyfriend, and I thought that it was because I was too fat.

definition: Your brain is the part of your body that is inside your head.
example: The brain is the part of the body that thinks and controls the rest of the body through the nervous system.

definition: Bread is food made from mixing flour, water, and yeast.
example: Small children love eating bread and butter.

definition: If you break something, you make it come apart in a way that cannot easily be put back together, usually by force.
example: He injured his leg and broke his foot during the crash.

definition: Breakfast is the first meal that we eat in the morning.
example: I'm late for school. I don't have time for breakfast today.

definition: Anything which avoids something which blocks a path, usually water, by going over the top of it.
example: The Golden Gate Bridge connects the two sides of California.

definition: If something is bright it gives out or fills with much light.
example: The sun is very bright during summer.

definition: When you say "you bring" something to someone, you carry it with you to that someone.
example: You bring lunch to me every day.

definition: Something that is broken is not as it should be because it has been damaged or injured
example: The broken cup lay in pieces on the floor.

definition: Your brother is another male child of one or both of your parents.
example: Two sisters and their brother played in the park yesterday

definition: If you brush something, you clean it with a brush.
example: I forgot to brush my teeth before going to bed.

definition: If you build something, you make it out of pieces of other things.
example: I built the house with wood and stone.

definition: A building consists of walls, a foundation and a roof that together close in some space.
example: I work in the Chrysler Building.

definition: A bus is a vehicle that carries a large number of people on roads.
example: He ran to catch the school bus, which had stopped at a corner to pick up more kids.

definition: Business is the buying and selling of things or services.
example: I am in the business of catching fish and selling them.
